public_body: North Adams City Council General Government Committee
overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: a member of the public who notified the chair could record the open session, and the chair's missing start-of-meeting announcement did not restrict that right. The AG reminded the committee of the chair's duty to announce recordings but ordered no remedy.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the committee restricted her right to record its July 20, 2021 open meeting, after the chair made no announcement that the meeting was being recorded.
allegations.key_passage: we do not find that the lack of such announcement restricted the complainant’s right to record the meeting.

allegations.summary: Whether the chair violated the law by failing to announce at the start of the meeting that it was being recorded; the complaint did not raise this issue.
allegations.key_passage: The complaint does not allege, and therefore we do not address herein, whether President Blackmer, as Chair of the Committee, violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to make an announcement at the start of the meeting informing attendees that the meeting was being recorded.
